services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Sail through Fort Lauderdale at golden hour with your own drinks, playlist, and dedicated skipper. There is no more magical time to experience Fort Lauderdale’s waterways than golden hour. As the South Florida sun dips below the horizon, the sky lights up in brilliant shades of amber, violet, and crimson, casting a golden glow over luxury yachts, palm-lined canals, and illuminated downtown bridges. Our private Sunset Cruise offers an intimate, romantic, and celebratory evening on the water.
